text.tspan: One point per task, in units of (score − random) / (1 − random), so 0 is a random policy and 1 a solved task; the diagonal is no change.
Each panel shades one quadrant and draws only its two bounds.
The quadrants are mirror images: 0.25 is barely off random, 0.60 is most of the way to solved.

tspan.tspan: Rescued: ours 32 of 150; CKA-RL, fine-tuning and from-scratch none. Lost: ours none; CKA-RL 2, fine-tuning 15, from-scratch 20.

text.tspan: Ours is 3 complete seeds (150 points), the others 1 each (50 points).
